{{Quote|The Emperor is very anxious to learn of the subjugation of this solar system is proceeding...|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 76">[[Star Wars (1977) 76|''Star Wars'' (1977) 76]]</ref>}}
The '''Subjugation of the Iskalon system''' was a protracted [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] campaign in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] to bring the [[Iskalon system/Legends|Iskalon system]] into line after [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] agent [[Tay Vanis]] had fomented rebellious dissent among the [[Star system/Legends|star system's]] [[Planet/Legends|planets]].

The Empire proceeded to subjugate the worlds of [[Decimation of Telfrey|Telfrey]] and [[Subjugation of Gamandar|Gamandar]], and occupied the planet [[Iskalon/Legends|Iskalon]] without force.
